formIdentityNote: No official Maine form exists for a 16 M.R.S. § 709 inspection and correction request and the statute prescribes none, so the request is a composed, controlled, participant-signed letter — exactly what the legal-design record resolves (custom_pleading on the correction unit). The base unit files nothing at all: § 703(2) confidentiality is automatic, no court has any role, and generating a court form for a Maine non-conviction would be affirmatively wrong.
